values.note: Every campsite has water and electric. Only sites 4 and 5 are full service (30-amp electric, water and sewer); the park does not state the amperage of the other sites.

hookups.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/cheraw/camping ('Each campsite is packed gravel and has individual water and electrical hookups'; 'Campsites 4 and 5 are full service sites with the electricity(30 amp), water and sewer'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Packed-gravel sites: the park lists 17 standard water/electric sites plus full-service sites 4 and 5, and five rustic tent sites; six sites are waterfront on Lake Juniper. Pull-throughs take RVs up to 40 ft, other sites up to 34 ft. Boat-in and primitive group areas besides.

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/cheraw/camping ('The pull-through sites accommodate RVs up to 40 feet, others up to 34 feet'; 'Standard Sites with Elec. & Water: 17 sites'; 'Six sites are waterfront on Lake Juniper'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/cheraw/camping ('restrooms with hot showers'; 'A dump station is available for RVs'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; per the --AWH note, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum stay 14 nights. Same-day reservations go through the park (843-537-9656). Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/cheraw/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; same-day via the park) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/cheraw/campsites (policies: 'Reservations may be made up to 13 months in advance', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 nights'), read 2026-10-21; single-night waiver from the entry's --AWH note

summary: Confirmed reservable on SC's own site with the 13-month window and 2-night minimum (now on the entry with the AWH phone waiver). Added water at every site and sewer at sites 4-5 (30-amp there; other sites' amps not stated, so electric left unset), RVs to 40 ft on pull-throughs, showers, dump, 14-night max. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Not stated: total RV site count unambiguously, season.
